witness: HERDR_ENV="2", HERDR_BIN_PATH="/usr/local/bin/herdr", HERDR_PANE_ID="w1:p7": readHerdrEnvironment -> null, herdr_env_ready("2","/usr/local/bin/herdr","w1:p7") -> true
notes: Seen by reading types.ail:1433, confirmed by execution: 20,687 of 50,789 generated cases (G1 11,664, G2 908, G3 8,115); in G2 the AILANG side admits exactly the 227 of 400 strings that sort after "1". The five inline tests of herdr_env_ready do not include such a value. Negative control: with `==` in place of `>=` (scratch copy) this repro exits 0 and the class count is 0.

claim: readHerdrEnvironment rejects HERDR_BIN_PATH only when it is undefined (`bin === undefined`), so HERDR_BIN_PATH="" opens the TypeScript gate with an empty binary while herdr_env_ready (bin_path != "") is false.
witness: HERDR_ENV="1", HERDR_BIN_PATH="" (set, empty), HERDR_PANE_ID="w1:p7": readHerdrEnvironment -> {"paneId":"w1:p7","bin":""}, herdr_env_ready("1","","w1:p7") -> false
notes: Seen by reading herdr-agent-state.ts:164 (paneId uses truthiness, bin uses `=== undefined`), confirmed by execution: 104 of 50,789 cases. Contradicts the function's own comment ("a pane id with no binary cannot report") and the AILANG inline test (("1", "", "w1:p7"), false); the TS test file has no HERDR_BIN_PATH="" case. Effect, executed (bun ../out/p11/bin_empty_effect.ts .): initHerdrReporter returns true and every report/release spawns "" which throws ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE inside fire()'s catch, so Motoko is silently invisible to herdr. In the full pipeline (X-2) the gate decisions happen to coincide, because buildChildEnv drops the empty value and register.ail then defaults it to "herdr" (A2-T1-3). Reachable only if HERDR_BIN_PATH is set but empty in the TUI's environment. Negative control: with `!bin` (scratch copy) this repro exits 0.
